name: SimplyBea Salon
description: SimplyBea Salon is a relaxed, welcoming salon offering silver and pastel color, lived-in blondes, healthy-hair treatments, and cuts that feel like therapy for your hair.

hero.title: Hair therapy for the real you.
hero.subtitle: Silver, pastel, and lived-in color, healthy-hair treatments, and easy cuts in a calm, happy space — book your session today.

stylists.name: Bea
stylists.title: Owner & Lead Stylist
stylists.bio: Bea founded SimplyBea to make every appointment feel like hair therapy. She loves silvers, lavenders, and soft lived-in color, and she believes healthy hair and good vibes go hand in hand.

reviews.name: Danielle F.
reviews.text: Bea turned my brassy blonde into the most gorgeous icy silver. My hair still feels soft and healthy. Obsessed!

reviews.name: Courtney H.
reviews.text: Truly hair therapy. Relaxing, fun, and I always leave feeling like a new person.

reviews.name: Melissa G.
reviews.text: She nailed the lavender I've wanted for years. So talented and so sweet. Highly recommend SimplyBea!

reviews.name: Alyssa N.
reviews.text: Best cut and color I've had in ages. The salon has such a warm, happy vibe.
